We considered two broad classes of applications in which AI text generation systems are used: reply scenarios, such as autoreplies or conversations with AI assistants or chatbots; and continuation scenarios, such as composing emails, writing text messages, or generating stories from a prompt.
We introduce FairPrism, a dataset of 5,000 examples of AI-generated English text with detailed human annotations covering a diverse set of harms relating to gender and sexuality.
